affected_subject.reason: Identifies WERC7575ShareToken batchTransfers and rBatchTransfers validator-only functions.

trigger_or_action.reason: Validator calling batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers to move balances between arbitrary addresses.

direct_effect.reason: Balances moved to non-KYC/sanctioned addresses bypassing KYC gate; pause also bypassed.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Standard transfer enforces isKycVerified establishing intended invariant that batch paths violate.

summary: Report identifies affected batch transfer functions, validator trigger, KYC/pause bypass effect, and the intended KYC invariant from standard transfer flow, sufficient to attempt formalization.
